</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This drives customer complaints and forces teams to correct outgoing correspondence by hand.\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- 6 accounts have raised this issue across 17 mentions [i:25835ba3516556af] [i:3d0d294c739f0b5a] [i:424a2d5ef215b36f] [i:685a9720c023a304] [i:784bbcdb220c64b5] [i:7aef4ffdc807927e] [i:8298ade66ebf300a] [i:8570557b63638d09] [i:94b3f25372ed0d07] [i:99ed97781fb395fd] account management [i:25835ba3516556af] [i:424a2d5ef215b36f] [i:7aef4ffdc807927e]\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance, with ARR of £1250000.0, reports that the system merges joint policyholder names incorrectly, sometimes showing only 1 or the wrong name, and that this is causing real issues with policyholders [i:25835ba3516556af]\n- Linnet House Insurance, with ARR of £360000.0, reports trouble with joint policyholder names in outgoing letters and says the system only pulls through 1 name, sometimes the wrong name [i:3d0d294c739f0b5a] [i:d407ed3449dc6468]\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance, with ARR of £2400000.0, reports that the system is not merging both names correctly and that it has had 3 complaints in a month because joint policyholder names were not merged correctly [i:424a2d5ef215b36f] [i:e6658c452bc7b9b7]\n- Stannary Commercial, with ARR of £540000.0, reports repeated issues where letters to joint policyholders only display 1 name, leading to complaints, and asks when joint policyholder names will appear correctly in correspondence [i:685a9720c023a304] [i:99ed97781fb395fd]\n- Tarnholt Drive Cover, with ARR of £290000.0, reports that letters merging multiple names cause real problems, with clients complaining that only 1 name shows up and sometimes not the right name, and that this is triggering formal complaints [i:7aef4ffdc807927e] [i:e037456841d6f0ee]\n- Saltmarsh Specialty, with ARR of £740000.0, reports that letters to joint policyholders only show 1 name, causing confusion, and that clients are complaining and its reputation on 2027-01-15 [i:685a9720c023a304] [i:7aef4ffdc807927e] [i:424a2d5ef215b36f]\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance (sales): the system merges joint policyholder names incorrectly, sometimes showing only 1 or the wrong name, and it is causing real issues with policyholders [i:25835ba3516556af]\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance (sales): a few joint policyholder cases have letters coming out with mismatched names, causing complaints [i:784bbcdb220c64b5]\n- Linnet House Insurance (sales): when letters go out for policies with 2 named holders, the system only includes 1 name, and sometimes it is the wrong name, which has led to frustrated calls from policyholders and extra work for the team to fix the letters manually [i:8570557b63638d09]\n- Linnet House Insurance (sales): the team is manually editing letters before sending, which is time-consuming and prone to error with joint policyholder names [i:f8fc05a94087512b]\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (support): the system is not merging both names correctly and is only showing 1 joint policyholder name [i:424a2d5ef215b36f]\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (support): a repeat issue where letters sent to joint policyholders show only 1 name is causing confusion and complaints from customers [i:a63d773b605f22e0]\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (support): 3 complaints in a month arose just because joint policyholder names were not merged correctly [i:e6658c452bc7b9b7]\n- Stannary Commercial (support): repeated issues where letters sent to joint policyholders only display 1 name lead to complaints, and joint policyholder names need to appear correctly in all communications [i:685a9720c023a304]\n- Stannary Commercial (support): letters to joint policyholders only show 1 name, causing real friction with clients [i:8298ade66ebf300a]\n- Tarnholt Drive Cover (account management): the issue with letters merging multiple names is causing real problems, with clients complaining because only 1 name shows up and sometimes it is not even the right name [i:7aef4ffdc807927e]\n- Tarnholt Drive Cover (account management): a recurring issue with joint policyholder letters pulling through only 1 name is causing complaints [i:d61d91ee782cd24c]\n- Saltmarsh Specialty (support): letters to joint policyholders only show 1 name, causing confusion [i:94b3f25372ed0d07]\n- Saltmarsh Specialty (support): letters sent to joint policyholders merge only 1 name, and clients are complaining and its reputation is being hurt [i:e9c39352aaac377c]\n\n## Why now\n\n- 3 accounts have renewals within 90 days, including Stannary Commercial on 2026-12-05, Tarnholt Drive Cover on 2027-01-09 and Hollinbrook Home Insurance on 2027-01-15 [i:685a9720c023a304] [i:7aef4ffdc807927e] [i:424a2d5ef215b36f]\n- The affected accounts represent ARR of £5580000.0 in total, with individual ARR figures of £1250000.0, £360000.0, £2400000.0, £540000.0, £290000.0 and £740000.0 [i:25835ba3516556af] [i:3d0d294c739f0b5a] [i:424a2d5ef215b36f] [i:685a9720c023a304] [i:7aef4ffdc807927e] [i:94b3f25372ed0d07]\n- The issue is being raised across 3 routes, with 6 mentions from sales, 8 from support and 3 from account management, indicating it is not confined to a single team [i:25835ba3516556af] [i:424a2d5ef215b36f] [i:7aef4ffdc807927e]\n- Stannary Commercial is asking when joint policyholder names can be expected to appear correctly in correspondence, so an answer is already owed [i:99ed97781fb395fd]\n- Teams are absorbing the cost today through manual letter edits that are time-consuming and prone to error [i:f8fc05a94087512b]\n",
